editable_regions.helpers: between `// <helpers>` and `// </helpers>`: helper spec fns and exec helpers
editable_regions.code: between `// ` and `// `: exactly one block `{ ... }`, the body of the function under spec

fixed: Everything outside the three editable regions is fixed: the `use` lines, the <preamble> block (definitions, spec fns, and any exec fns given there), the <spec> block (signature, requires, ensures of the function under test), fn main, and all marker comments. Compared token-wise; comments and whitespace are ignored.
